# lmw profile posts

Show a member's recent posts

```
lmw profile posts PROFILE [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw profile posts ada-lovelace -n 5
```

### Options

```
      --full        show complete post texts
  -h, --help        help for posts
  -n, --limit int   number of posts (1-50) (default 10)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
